name: Cost Estimate
description:
Scan any codebase (GitHub URL or local path) and calculate what a real dev team would charge to build it. Analyzes complexity
  across 7 factors, estimates human hours, and produces a detailed cost report for 6 hiring scenarios: Solo Dev (US), Lean
  Startup (US), Growth Company (US), Enterprise (US), Polish Software House, and Polish Internal Team. Includes 2025-2026 market
  rates from Bulldogjob, JustJoinIT, NoFluffJobs, Salary.com, and Glassdoor. Shows AI-assisted development ROI with speed
  multiplier and cost savings vs traditional teams.
longDescription:
Ships **1 skill**, `cost-estimate` (This skill should be used when the user asks to 'estimate build cost', 'how much would this cost…).

Installs with `claude plugin install cost-estimate@claude-community` from `exhuman777/cost-estimate`.
